name: Bun nuoc leo
summary: Bún nước lèo is a Soc Trang noodle soup in a fish-stock broth, with pickled river fish, shrimp, roasted pork, crackling, fish balls, herbs, soy beans, and banana blossom. In Can Tho, eat it on Đề Thám or at the Mỹ Khánh garden tables.
origin: Soc Trang, 60 km southeast of Can Tho. It is served in Can Tho and Tra Vinh too.
howToEat: Order a bowl on Đề Thám, or with the garden lunch at Mỹ Khánh.
where: Đề Thám, Can Tho’s food street.
Tra Vinh, on the road into Can Tho.
seoTitle: Bun nuoc leo served in Can Tho
seoDescription: Soc Trang’s fish-stock noodle soup with pickled river fish, roasted pork, and banana blossom, served on Đề Thám and at Mỹ Khánh.
